pan-bazar.name: Pan Bazar
pan-bazar.about:
Pan Bazar, also spelt Panbazar, is part of Guwahati's old city centre and sits on the south bank of the Brahmaputra, with Paltan Bazaar, Ambari and Fancy Bazaar around it. The name means betel-leaf market. Today it is known for administrative buildings such as the district court and a Reserve Bank branch, for bookshops and printing presses, and for the wholesale medicine trade, with the Dighalipukhuri tank and the Kachari Ghat river jetty nearby.

Much of the frontage is shops and offices, so homes here are usually flats above or behind the market streets and older houses in the lanes. Guwahati railway station in neighbouring Paltan Bazaar is close, and city buses and autos run through the area, which suits tutors coming from other parts of the old city. Weekday office and market hours make the main streets busy, so early morning or later evening classes are easier to keep on time. A clear lane landmark and the floor number help on the first visit. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

paltan-bazaar.name: Paltan Bazaar
paltan-bazaar.about:
Paltan Bazaar is the transport hub of central Guwahati. Guwahati railway station, the city's busiest, stands here, with the state transport bus terminal at its rear and many private bus operators, hotels and offices close by. The locality is surrounded by Pan Bazaar, Ulubari, Rehabari and Fancy Bazaar, and the Assam Trunk (AT) Road gives it links to the rest of the city.

Housing is a mix of flats in older and newer buildings among the shops and hotels, with more settled residential lanes towards Rehabari and Ulubari. For a tutor this is one of the easiest addresses to reach by bus or train, but the station area is crowded through the day, so agree on a pick-up point or a clear lane landmark. Evening slots after the office rush and weekend mornings tend to work well, and families who want a specialist subject tutor from another part of the city can also choose online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

uzan-bazar.name: Uzan Bazar
uzan-bazar.about:
Uzan Bazar is one of the oldest settlements in Guwahati, a residential and commercial area in the north of the city with the Brahmaputra running alongside. It includes the historic Rajbari compound, once linked to the Ahom royal family, and a riverfront park that draws families in the evenings. Several families of the old Ahom line later moved from Rajbari towards the Zoo Road Tiniali and Gitanagar side of the city.

Homes range from older independent houses on family plots to apartment buildings, some with a river view. Houses allow doorstep arrival, while apartment buildings may ask a visiting tutor to sign in at the gate, so share the building name and a phone number for the guard. City buses, autos and shared taxis link Uzan Bazar with Pan Bazar, Paltan Bazaar and the GS Road side, and Guwahati railway station is not far. Evenings near the riverside get busy, so an afternoon or early evening slot usually suits. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ulubari.name: Ulubari
ulubari.about:
Ulubari lies in the centre of Guwahati between Paltan Bazaar and Bhangagarh. GS Road runs through the locality and the Ulubari flyover carries through traffic over it, while the Assam Trunk (AT) Road is close at hand. The city's main multipurpose stadium and an indoor stadium built for the 2007 National Games are here, so sports events add to the crowd on some days.

Housing is mostly low-rise and mid-rise apartment buildings, with some older houses in the side lanes. Guwahati railway station is easy to reach, and buses along GS Road connect Ulubari with Ganeshguri, Six Mile and Beltola, so tutors from both the old city and the south can reach it. Apartment buildings may need a quick gate entry, so tell the guard to expect the tutor. GS Road gets heavy in the evening peak, so a slightly earlier or later class time helps. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

chandmari.name: Chandmari
chandmari.about:
Chandmari is one of the oldest localities of Guwahati, on the eastern side of the city. It is home to the city's All India Radio centre and to several high schools, colleges and coaching institutes, which gives it a strong student feel. Its playground has hosted a Bohag Bihu celebration every year since 1961. The residential neighbourhoods around it include Milanpur, Krishnanagar, Nizarapar, Bamunimaidam, Kannachal, Pub-Sarania and Bhaskar Nagar.

Housing is a mix of older independent houses and apartment buildings, with many rented flats taken by students and small families. Zoo Road begins at Chandmari and runs towards Ganeshguri, so tutors from the Zoo Road and GS Road side can reach it easily, and Guwahati railway station is within the central part of the city. In houses a tutor can come straight to the door; for flats, share the building name and floor. Because many coaching classes run in the evening, a fixed weekday slot agreed in advance keeps home tuition regular. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

zoo-road.name: Zoo Road
zoo-road.about:
Zoo Road is both a main road and a residential locality in central Guwahati. The road runs from Chandmari to Ganeshguri and takes its name from the state zoo and botanical garden beside it; a city park is also close by. Neighbouring areas include Chandmari, AIDC, Junali, Ambikagirinagar, Ulubari and Laxmi Nagar, and the VIP Road links Zoo Road with the eastern side of the city.

Homes are mainly multistorey apartments, with builder floors and independent houses in the lanes on either side of the road. Buses and autos run the length of Zoo Road, which makes it easy for tutors living in Chandmari, Ganeshguri or Ulubari to take on a class here. Apartment buildings often keep a visitor register at the gate, so let the guard know the tutor's name. The road is busy in the evening peak, so a class that starts a little after the rush is easier to keep on time. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lachit-nagar.name: Lachit Nagar
lachit-nagar.about:
Lachit Nagar is a central residential locality close to Zoo Tiniali and South Sarania. It connects GS Road with the Zoo Road side, and Rajgarh Road links it with Chandmari and the rest of the city. Much of the housing is builder floors and small apartment buildings, often in three-bedroom layouts, with some independent houses in the inner lanes.

Because it sits between two busy corridors, tutors who already teach on GS Road, Zoo Road or in Chandmari can usually fit a class here without a long trip, and Guwahati railway station is not far for tutors coming by train. Builder floors generally allow doorstep arrival, while apartment buildings may ask for a quick gate entry. The lanes are narrow in places, so tell the tutor where a two-wheeler or car can be parked. Evenings on GS Road are busy, so late afternoon or weekend classes are often the easiest to keep regular. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bhangagarh.name: Bhangagarh
bhangagarh.about:
Bhangagarh is a busy central locality on GS Road, surrounded by Paltan Bazaar, Chandmari and Ganeshguri, with Ulubari and Rupnagar next door. It is known for its market and for a cluster of large government and private hospitals, which bring a steady flow of visitors through the day. The Assam Trunk (AT) Road is also close, and Guwahati railway station in Paltan Bazaar is the nearest main station.

Housing is a mix of apartment buildings and older residential buildings, which makes it a practical central address for families. Tutors can reach Bhangagarh easily by the buses that run along GS Road from both the old city and the south. Traffic around the hospital area and on GS Road is heavy at peak hours, so agree a class time outside the busiest part of the evening. For apartment buildings, share the building name, floor and a phone number for the gate. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ganeshguri.name: Ganeshguri
ganeshguri.about:
Ganeshguri, named after Lord Ganesh, is one of the main commercial areas of Guwahati and the heart of the southern sub-centre that has grown around the capital complex at Dispur. A Ganesh temple stands in its southern part. The market here covers everything from garments and home goods to groceries and restaurants, and the city's tea auction centre is close by. GS Road passes through, and Zoo Road starts from Chandmari and ends at Ganeshguri.

Behind the shops, the residential lanes hold apartment buildings, builder floors and independent houses. Buses and autos from all directions pass through Ganeshguri, which makes it one of the easier places in the south for a tutor to reach, and Guwahati railway station is the nearest main station. The junction is known for heavy traffic, so weekday evening classes work better when timed around the rush. For flats, share the building name and floor; for houses, a lane landmark is enough. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dispur.name: Dispur
dispur.about:
Dispur has been the capital of Assam since 1973, when the seat of government moved from Shillong. It was a small village then and grew quickly as people settled around the capital complex, which holds the Assam Secretariat and the Legislative Assembly. The Assam Trunk Road and GS Road both pass through Dispur, the Bharalu river flows through it, and Jatia, Rukminigaon, Hatigaon and Six Mile are among its neighbours.

Most homes are in apartment buildings, with builder floors and some independent houses in the older lanes. Government offices make the roads around the capital complex busy at office opening and closing times, so after-school slots that avoid those hours are easier for a visiting tutor. Buses along GS Road connect Dispur with Ganeshguri, Beltola and the city centre. Apartment gates usually ask for the visitor's name and flat number, so pass these on to the tutor before the demo class. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

rukminigaon.name: Rukminigaon
rukminigaon.about:
Rukminigaon, also written Rukmini Gaon, is a residential locality in south Guwahati just off GS Road, close to Dispur. Its neighbours include Beltola, Hatigaon and Six Mile, and it falls within the southern part of the city that has grown up around the capital complex. Most homes are flats in multistorey apartment buildings, with a smaller number of independent houses in the lanes.

Many families here live a short walk from the main road, so a tutor coming by bus along GS Road usually has an easy last stretch on foot or by auto. Apartment buildings may keep a visitor register, so tell the guard the tutor's name and flat number in advance. Parking can be tight in some lanes, which is worth mentioning to a tutor who drives. GS Road is busiest in the evening, so classes that start after the peak, or on weekend mornings, are simpler to keep regular. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

hatigaon.name: Hatigaon
hatigaon.about:
Hatigaon is a residential locality in southern Guwahati, surrounded by Ganeshguri, Bhetapara, Sijubari and Survey, with Beltola, Kahilipara and Rukminigaon also close by. Local history links the name with the elephants of the Beltola royal family, which were kept and trained here. The area has grown quickly in recent decades as part of the city's southern sub-centre, and several hospitals are located here.

Housing is mostly apartment buildings with two- and three-bedroom flats, along with independent houses and some plots in the lanes away from the main road. Tutors from Ganeshguri, Beltola and the GS Road side can reach Hatigaon by bus or auto. Apartment buildings usually ask visitors to sign in, so share the building name and a phone number for the guard. The main road is busy in the evening, so an agreed weekday slot a little before or after the rush helps classes run on time. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kahilipara.name: Kahilipara
kahilipara.about:
Kahilipara is a residential area in south Guwahati, surrounded by Ganeshguri and Lalganesh. It is known for the many state education department offices located here, along with police battalion campuses and other government offices, so large institutional compounds sit next to ordinary neighbourhoods. Guwahati railway station in Paltan Bazaar is the nearest main station.

Homes include apartment buildings, independent houses and some larger villas, so arrangements for a tutor differ from lane to lane. Houses usually allow doorstep arrival, while apartment buildings may need a quick gate entry. Tutors from Ganeshguri, Dispur and Hatigaon can reach Kahilipara easily by bus or auto. Government office hours make some roads busy in the morning and late afternoon, so an evening or weekend slot often suits regular home tuition, with online classes as an option for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

beltola.name: Beltola
beltola.about:
Beltola is a large residential area in the south of Guwahati, next to the Dispur capital complex. It was once a small kingdom that survived until 1947, and the area has grown rapidly since the 1980s, now reaching the national highway at the southern edge of the city. Beltola Bazar, a twice-weekly fruit and vegetable market with roots in the late medieval period, is still held in the middle of the locality.

Homes are a mix of apartment buildings and traditional houses, and neighbouring localities include Six Mile, Jayanagar, Rukminigaon, Bhetapara, Survey and Khanapara, with Basistha to the south. Buses along GS Road and the highway connect Beltola with the rest of the city. Houses let a tutor come straight to the door, while apartment buildings may need a gate entry. Market days bring extra traffic near Beltola Bazar, so keep class timings clear of those hours if you live nearby. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

survey.name: Survey
survey.about:
Survey, often called Survey Beltola, is a residential locality in south Guwahati next to Hatigaon and Beltola, not far from the Dispur secretariat. Lanes such as Ajanta Path run off the main road, and a bus stop on the main road serves the area. Housing is mainly multistorey apartment buildings, with builder floors and independent houses in the quieter lanes.

Because many homes sit a short walk from the main road, a tutor coming by city bus or auto has an easy last leg. Tutors living in Beltola, Hatigaon, Ganeshguri or Six Mile can usually take on a class here without a long trip. For apartment buildings, share the building name, floor and a phone number for the guard, and mention where a two-wheeler can be parked. The main road through Beltola and Survey gets busy in the evening, so fix a weekday slot that suits both sides before the demo class. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

six-mile.name: Six Mile
six-mile.about:
Six Mile is a major locality in southern Guwahati on GS Road, and one of the areas that make up the southern sub-centre around Dispur. The Six Mile flyover links it with the national highway, Jayanagar Road connects it with the adjoining neighbourhoods, and the Bharalu river passes through. Beltola Tiniali, Jayanagar, Dwarandha and Mathura Nagar are close by.

Homes here are mostly flats in apartment buildings, with shops and offices along GS Road and quieter residential lanes behind. Guwahati railway station is the main station for the area, and Narangi station is an alternative. City buses along GS Road make Six Mile easy to reach for tutors from Ganeshguri, Beltola and Khanapara. Apartment buildings often keep a visitor register, so tell the guard to expect the tutor. GS Road traffic builds in the evening, so an earlier after-school slot or a weekend class helps. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

khanapara.name: Khanapara
khanapara.about:
Khanapara is in the far south of Guwahati, towards the border with Meghalaya, and is a hub for regional road transport. Large government campuses, including the state public service commission and a veterinary college, sit alongside residential areas, and there is an indoor stadium and a regional science centre. Neighbouring localities include Beltola, Bhetapara, Jayanagar, Lalmati and Patarkuchi.

Housing is mostly apartment buildings, with some builder floors, houses and plots in the lanes. Buses from the city centre and GS Road reach Khanapara, and tutors from Beltola, Six Mile or Jayanagar can reach it easily. Apartment buildings usually ask for the visitor's name and flat number at the gate, so share these before the first class. Regional traffic makes the main road busy at peak times, so plan class timings around it, and consider online classes for specialist subjects if a suitable tutor lives further away. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

basistha.name: Basistha
basistha.about:
Basistha is a residential locality at the southern edge of Guwahati. Beltola lies to its north, Patarkuchi to the east, the Ri-Bhoi district of Meghalaya to the south and the Garbhanga wildlife sanctuary to the west. The Basistha temple and ashram, on the river of the same name at the southern edge of the locality, is a place of worship and a popular picnic spot. The national highway passes through Basistha Chariali.

Homes include apartment buildings, among them a large residential complex built for the 2007 National Games, as well as independent houses and plots in quieter lanes. Tutors from Beltola, Six Mile and Patarkuchi can reach the area by bus or auto along the highway and the Beltola road. Independent houses allow doorstep arrival, while large complexes need a gate entry with the tower and flat number. Share a clear landmark, as some lanes are away from the main road. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

maligaon.name: Maligaon
maligaon.about:
Maligaon is in the west of Guwahati, below the Nilachal hill on which the Kamakhya temple stands. It is the headquarters of the Northeast Frontier Railway, which runs rail operations across the Northeast, and Kamakhya Junction, the city's second-largest station, is located here. The western corridor through Kamakhya, Pandu and Maligaon carries the main rail and road link out of Guwahati, and the locality is known for its Durga Puja celebrations.

Housing is mostly apartment buildings, with builder floors and some older houses, and a large railway presence alongside. For tutors, Kamakhya Junction and the city buses make Maligaon easy to reach from Adabari, Jalukbari and Pandu, while those from the GS Road side face a longer cross-city trip. Apartment buildings may ask visitors to sign in at the gate. Plan class times around the busy stretch near the station, and use online classes for subjects with fewer local tutors. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

adabari.name: Adabari
adabari.about:
Adabari is a busy commercial locality in west Guwahati, between Jalukbari and Maligaon. Pandu lies to its north and Kamakhya to its east, the national highway runs to its west, and the Assam Trunk Road and Kamakhya Junction station lie to its south. Adabari Tiniali, a three-way junction of the Pandu Port Road, the Assam Trunk Road and the lane into Kamakhya Nagar, is its focal point, and its bus depot serves towns across lower Assam.

Homes here are mostly apartment buildings, with some builder floors and houses in the lanes around Kamakhya Nagar. Kamakhya Junction and the city buses make Adabari easy to reach for tutors from Maligaon, Jalukbari and Pandu. The junction and bus depot are busy through the day, so agree a precise pick-up point or lane landmark for the first visit. Apartment buildings may keep a visitor register at the gate, so let the guard know the tutor's name. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jalukbari.name: Jalukbari
jalukbari.about:
Jalukbari is in the west of Guwahati, on the banks of the Brahmaputra, where the city's western corridor divides into the road to North Guwahati over the Saraighat bridges and the road west towards the airport. It is home to a large state university campus and an engineering college. Dharapur, Khanamukh and Lankeswar are nearby, and Kamakhya Junction is the nearest railway station.

Housing is mostly multistorey apartment buildings, with some builder floors, houses and plots, and the university area gives the locality a large student population. Tutors from Adabari, Maligaon and Dharapur can reach Jalukbari by city bus, and those in North Guwahati come across the bridge. The junction carries heavy highway traffic, so tutors crossing it should plan class timings around the peak. Apartment gates usually ask for the flat number, so share it before the demo class. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

north-guwahati.name: North Guwahati
north-guwahati.about:
North Guwahati lies on the north bank of the Brahmaputra and is being gradually incorporated into the city limits. It was the site of the ancient city of Durjaya, a capital of the Kamarupa kingdom, and it has old temples such as Doul Govinda. A national technology institute has had its permanent campus here since the 1990s. Housing is more spread out than in the city: independent houses, residential plots and a smaller number of apartment buildings.

Three bridges now cross the river at Guwahati: the rail-cum-road Saraighat bridge opened in 1962, the New Saraighat bridge beside it in 2017, and a six-lane road bridge opened in February 2026 that links the city directly with North Guwahati. Even so, a tutor coming from the south bank has a long ride, so ask for a nearby tutor where possible. Houses allow doorstep arrival; share a clear landmark, since lanes can be hard to find. Online classes are a practical choice for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Old City & Riverfront.fact: The core of old Guwahati consists of Pan Bazaar, Paltan Bazaar, Fancy Bazaar and Uzan Bazaar, each with its own urban activities.
Guwahati railway station (code GHY), the busiest station in the city, is in Paltan Bazaar; it is an A1-category station with the state transport bus terminal at its rear.
Pan Bazaar is on the bank of the Brahmaputra and is surrounded by Paltan Bazaar, Ambari and Fancy Bazaar; Kachari Ghat next to the district court is a local river port.
Uzan Bazar is one of the oldest settlements in Guwahati, in the north of the city beside the Brahmaputra, and includes the historic Rajbari compound.
Ulubari is in the centre of Guwahati and is surrounded by Bhangagarh and Paltan Bazaar.
Guwahati has no metro in operation; the Guwahati Metro is described as a proposed system with four corridors planned in its first phase.

Chandmari & Zoo Road.fact: Chandmari is one of the oldest localities of Guwahati, on the eastern side of the city; Bohag Bihu has been held at its playground since 1961.
Zoo Road runs from Chandmari to Ganeshguri and is named for the state zoo; the locality is surrounded by Chandmari and AIDC.
The VIP Road links Zoo Road with Guwahati's eastern corridor towards Noonmati and Narengi.
Bhangagarh is surrounded by Paltan Bazaar, Chandmari and Ganeshguri, and its nearest railway station is Guwahati station at Paltan Bazaar.
Lachit Nagar is close to Zoo Tiniali and South Sarania and is connected to the city by GS Road and Rajgarh Road.

GS Road & Dispur.fact: The Guwahati-Shillong (GS) Road is the city's most important corridor, running south from the centre with shops and offices along the road and dense housing behind it.
Dispur became the capital of Assam in 1973; the first sitting of the Assam Legislative Assembly at Dispur was held on 16 March 1973.
The Assam Trunk Road and GS Road both pass through Dispur, which holds the Assam Secretariat and Legislative Assembly.
Ganeshguri, Beltola, Hatigaon, Six Mile and Panjabari have formed a southern sub-centre of Guwahati around the capital complex at Dispur.
The Guwahati Tea Auction Centre, next to the capital complex at Dispur, held its first sale on 25 September 1970.
Hatigaon is surrounded by Ganeshguri, Bhetapara, Sijubari and Survey.

Beltola & Khanapara.fact: Beltola adjoins the Dispur capital complex; it has grown rapidly since the 1980s and now extends south to the national highway at the city's southern edge.
Beltola Bazar is a twice-weekly fruit and vegetable market dating back to the late medieval period.
Beltola was a small Koch kingdom that survived under British rule until it joined the Union of India in 1947.

A national highway bypass (named NH-37 in this source; property portals and the Beltola article describe the southern stretch as NH 27) encircles southern Guwahati, linking the GS Road corridor to Jalukbari in the west.
Basistha is bordered by Beltola to the north and the Ri-Bhoi district of Meghalaya to the south; the national highway passes through Basistha Chariali.
Khanapara, in the extreme south of Guwahati, is a hub for regional transport.
Six Mile is linked to NH 27 by the Six Mile flyover and to adjoining neighbourhoods by Jayanagar Road.

Maligaon, Jalukbari & North Guwahati.fact: Maligaon is the headquarters of the Northeast Frontier Railway zone.
Kamakhya Junction, earlier named Jalukbari, is at Maligaon and is the second-largest railway station in Guwahati.
The Saraighat Bridge, a rail-cum-road bridge over the Brahmaputra, was completed in September 1962; the New Saraighat Bridge beside it was inaugurated in January 2017.
The six-lane Kumar Bhaskar Varma Setu, the third bridge across the Brahmaputra at Guwahati, opened on 14 February 2026 and connects Guwahati with North Guwahati.
National Highway 17 from Sevoke in West Bengal ends at Jalukbari.
Adabari Tiniali is a three-way junction of the Pandu Port Road, the Assam Trunk Road and the lane into Kamakhya Nagar, and Adabari's bus depot serves lower Assam.
The North Guwahati area on the north bank of the Brahmaputra is being gradually incorporated into the city limits.
